_README.purpose: Targeting visuals for Edha talents (Foundry MeasuredTemplates). Two features in register-skills.js: (1) Attunement Range PREVIEW — a per-talent ⊙ button draws a range ring scaled to the talent's leyline color rank + reports tokens in range; this needs NO per-talent data (the color is derived at runtime from the talent's damage formula / activation skill / path). (2) AoE templates — talents listed HERE with an `area` drop a [Size] circle on use, centered on your target, and AUTO-TARGET the captured tokens so the talent's own damage/heal card applies to all of them with one Apply click.

fields.color: OPTIONAL leyline color override for range/size scaling (white/blue/black/red/green). Usually auto-derived; set it only when the formula doesn't name a color.
fields.affects: 'enemies' (default) | 'allies' (heals) | 'all' | 'none' (terrain — draw the circle but don't auto-target).
fields.area: { shape:'circle', sizeByRank:true } → size = [2.5,5,10,15,20] ft by the color's rank; OR { shape:'circle', sizeFt:N } for a fixed radius.

_README.scales: Attunement Range by rank = [15,30,60,90,120] ft; [Size] by rank = [2.5,5,10,15,20] ft.
_README.pilot: AoE wired for Flame Surge (enemy burst), Mending Aura (ally heal burst), Thorn Field (terrain marker). Range preview works for ALL color-scaled talents automatically. Save-for-half (Flame Surge) is applied full to all captured — halve the savers manually for now.
